name: SaaS Websites Component

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 500+ SaaS 网站截图库，先按页型选（404 / About Us / Career / Contact / FAQ / Integration / Landing / Legal / Login / Pricing / Signup / Solution / Support / Team / Testimonials 等），再按公司看整站，另有 User Flows 与 Emails 两块。
description.en: 500+ SaaS 网站截图库，先按页型选（404 / About Us / Career / Contact / FAQ / Integration / Landing / Legal / Login / Pricing / Signup / Solution / Support / Team / Testimonials 等），再按公司看整站，另有 User Flows 与 Emails 两块。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by SaaS Websites (https://saaswebsites.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏深蓝到紫的渐变底，最上面一条紫带推 New Free Guide: AI mentions on SaaS Homepages - 50 top SaaS websites analyzed。h1 写 Get Inspired by the Best SaaS Websites，下面一行 Select a Page Category: 接一大片白色胶囊按钮：404 Error Pages、About Us Pages、Blogs、Career Pages、Contact Pages、FAQs Pages、Integration Pages、Landing Pages、Legal Pages、Login Pages、Media Kit Pages、Pricing Pages、Product/Feature Pages、Resource Pages、SaaS Homepages、Search Results Pages、Signup Pages、Solution Pages、Support Pages、Team Pages、Testimonials Pages。往下 Latest SaaS Pages Added 一节按公司铺卡片，第一屏是 StackBlitz 的 Support page / Signup page / Pricing page / Login page，缩略图里写 StackBlitz Documentation 和 Simple, transparent pricing。顶栏右侧并列 Create Free Account、Sign In 和蓝色的 Discover SaaS Websites Pro。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
